existing_features.title: Create a responsive multi-section marketing website for the modern men’s fashion brand named “Column and Case” with a neat, clean, plain black-and-white aesthetic.
Implement a simple navigation and page structure suitable for a small fashion brand site: Home, Collection, About, and Contact (can be separate routes or clearly separated sections).
Add a “Collection” area presenting a clean product grid for modern menswear with placeholder items (e.g., outerwear, shirting, trousers, accessories), each showing an image, product name, and price.
Add an “About” section describing the brand in a minimal editorial style using English copy (short and restrained).
Add a “Contact” section with a simple contact form UI (name, email, message) and a clean footer with basic brand links.
Apply a coherent visual theme across the site that stays strictly black-and-white and feels modern, neat, clean, and plain (typography, spacing scale, button style, borders, and hover states).
Add and render generated static brand images from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not fetch images from the backend).
